notes: Recorded against tools/onboarding-factory/recording/mock-anthropic-error --status 401 --error-type authentication_error --succeed-after 0. MEASURED on claude-code 2.1.245, and it corrects this scenario's own premise: a 401 is NOT non-retryable for claude-code. It climbs a ten-attempt ladder with its own exponential backoff (the TUI reads `401 invalid x-api-key · Retrying in 7s · attempt 6/10`), ignores the retry-after header entirely, and takes 184s from ready→working to working→error. Nothing is written to the transcript for any attempt, so the session is GREEN for those three minutes; the only persisted record is the give-up line, error:"authentication_failed", apiErrorStatus:401, text "Invalid API key · Fix external API key". max_delay_ms below is set from that measurement with margin, not from a guess.
source: #1803 (Phase 5 of the #1796 error-state epic). The .specs/ catalog is gitignored and could not be read from a worktree; the expectations here are written against #1796's settled decisions and the recorded bytes.

text: The agent exhausts its retry ladder on the rejected credentials; working → error. The session never reaches ready and does not stick in working.
